goal: Enumeration and sweep of open-world evidence dimensions toward a ~100K-token per-asset dossier that compresses into a ~4K-token context4k.

dimensions.name: clothing/apparel
dimensions.hypothesis: Declared DOME-29 clothing/apparel measurements (coverage, garment classes, per-garment dominant colors) reduce unsupported clothing claims in captions on the frozen first-500 cohort.
dimensions.falsified_if: The clothing-evidence condition does not reduce unsupported clothing claims or increase supported claims versus its matched no-evidence baseline under fixed view/prompt/model/settings.
dimensions.deterministic_signal: seg2 DOME-29 Apparel(1)/Upper_Clothing(23)/Lower_Clothing(13)/Torso(22)/Socks/Shoes classes + per-class dominant color from source pixels
dimensions.data_snapshot: first-500 core-covered cohort; seg2 + source pixels
dimensions.selection_rationale: Clothing is a high-frequency hallucination risk and is deterministically measurable from existing seg2+pixels with no new model.

specialists.name: Florence-2-Flux-Large
specialists.scope: open-set clothing/apparel attribute tagging (garment type, color) from source pixels
known_failure_modes: long-tail garment names may drift from source truth

dimensions.name: hair
dimensions.hypothesis: Declared hair measurements (color, area fraction, length proxy) reduce invented hair-color/coverage claims.
dimensions.falsified_if: The hair-evidence condition does not improve claim support versus its matched no-evidence baseline.
dimensions.deterministic_signal: seg2 Hair(4) region area/position + dominant color from source pixels
dimensions.data_snapshot: first-500 core-covered cohort; seg2 + source pixels
dimensions.selection_rationale: Hair color/length is commonly hallucinated and is deterministically measurable from the existing Hair class.

dimensions.name: skin-color/tone
dimensions.hypothesis: Declared exposed-skin dominant color/tone reduces invented skin-tone claims.
dimensions.falsified_if: Skin-tone evidence does not improve supported claims or reduce unsupported color claims.
dimensions.deterministic_signal: seg2 Face_Neck(3)/limb skin regions + source pixel dominant color
dimensions.data_snapshot: first-500 core-covered cohort; seg2 + source pixels
dimensions.selection_rationale: Skin tone is a frequent hallucination target and is measurable from existing seg2 masks.

dimensions.name: body-type/proportions
dimensions.hypothesis: Declared anthropometric ratios (shoulder:hip, torso:leg, limb lengths) improve body/limb description support.
dimensions.falsified_if: Proportion evidence does not improve supported body/pose claims over baseline.
dimensions.deterministic_signal: pose2 Goliath-308 keypoints (shoulder/hip/limb ratios) + seg2 region fractions
dimensions.selection_rationale: Pose evidence already improved claims in arm #4; body proportions are the direct extension using the same keypoints.

dimensions.name: lighting
dimensions.hypothesis: Declared luminance/dynamic-range/lighting-direction statistics reduce invented shadow/lighting claims.
dimensions.falsified_if: Lighting evidence does not reduce unsupported lighting claims.
dimensions.data_snapshot: first-500 core-covered cohort; normal2 + source pixels
dimensions.selection_rationale: Lighting is a common soft-detail hallucination and is measurable from existing pixel/normal artifacts.

dimensions.name: setting/environment
dimensions.hypothesis: Declared background palette/non-subject statistics improve scene-environment claim support.
dimensions.falsified_if: Setting evidence does not improve supported scene claims or reduce invented background details.
dimensions.deterministic_signal: seg2 Background/non-subject region + source color palette
dimensions.data_snapshot: first-500 core-covered cohort; seg2 + source pixels
dimensions.selection_rationale: Background is frequently over-described and is measurable from the existing seg2 Background class.

dimensions.name: texture/material
dimensions.hypothesis: Declared per-region texture proxies (edge/gradient statistics) reduce invented material/texture claims.
dimensions.falsified_if: Texture evidence does not improve support or reduce unsupported material claims.
dimensions.deterministic_signal: per-mask gradient/edge statistics from source pixels (e.g. gradient magnitude inside seg2 regions)
dimensions.data_snapshot: first-500 core-covered cohort; seg2 + source pixels
dimensions.selection_rationale: Material/texture is a common hallucination and is measurable deterministically without new models.

specialists.name: Florence-2-large
specialists.scope: open-set material/texture/attribute description from source pixels
known_failure_modes: material attribution is confounded by lighting

dimensions.name: full-dossier assembly and context4k compression
dimensions.hypothesis: An expanded per-item dossier assembled from verified evidence dimensions (target >=100K tokens, claim-by-claim evidence links) can be compressed to a ~4K-token context4k artifact that preserves supported claims better than a plain 4K summarization baseline.
dimensions.falsified_if: context4k does not preserve supported claims at materially higher density than a 4K baseline summarization (round-trip claim-support audit not passed).
dimensions.deterministic_signal: Verified dimension specialists + relational determinations assembled per item
dimensions.selection_rationale: This is the program-level goal: ~100K descriptive tokens per asset compressed into ~4K context while keeping evidence links — beyond any single dimension.

specialists.name: ComfyUI reconstruction (SD1.5/SDXL/flux1Schnell)
specialists.scope: generate image from context4k/dossier; compare to source with CLIP ViT-L/14 similarity
known_failure_modes: generative model does not reproduce identity/subject exactly
CLIP score is a weak identity proxy
GPU time per item is large

dimensions.name: generative reconstruction validation (ComfyUI round-trip)
dimensions.hypothesis: Generative reconstruction is a valid, non-LLM measure of per-asset information preserved by a caption/context: images generated from a caption/context via local ComfyUI score higher in CLIP ViT-L/14 similarity against the original source than images generated from a degraded baseline (e.g. no context / truncated context), so reconstruction can validate the 100K->4K dossier pipeline independently of claim-support review.
dimensions.falsified_if: Reconstruction similarity does not correlate with information content (a fixed 4K context cannot be distinguished from a truncated/baseline context by CLIP score), or the diffusion checkpoint fails to decode the relevant attributes at all (ceiling effect / degenerate similarity).
dimensions.deterministic_signal: CLIP ViT-L/14 similarity (source vs generated-from-context4k, and source vs generated-from-degraded-baseline) via local ComfyUI over frozen diffusion checkpoints
dimensions.data_snapshot: first-500 core-covered cohort; local ComfyUI at /mnt/fscache/essdee/ComfyUI; 195 diffusion checkpoints at /mnt/nas-ai-models/checkpoints; CLIP ViT-L/14 openai/clip-vit-large-patch14 + timm/vit_large_patch14_clip_224.openai in HF cache
dimensions.selection_rationale: Claim-support review (gemma4/LLM) is the current sole downstream check on caption/PENDING dossier quality. Reconstruction adds a generation-grounded, non-LLM, end-to-end test that an independent reviewer cannot substitute for, and directly measures the top-level goal (context that regenerates the asset) rather than only claim agreement. It also exercises the underused local ComfyUI + NAS checkpoint inventory.
dimensions.scope: generative reconstruction of source images from dossier/context artifacts; CLIP ViT-L/14 similarity of generated vs source and vs degraded-baseline generations
dimensions.inputs: context4k.json / context4k.md / compression.json artifacts + source image (read-only canonical), frozen ComfyUI pipeline + one frozen diffusion checkpoint
dimensions.output_semantics: per-item CLIP ViT-L/14 cosine similarity (generated vs source); delta between context-driven and baseline generations; scale-invariant to camera framing
dimensions.provenance: local ComfyUI at /mnt/fscache/essdee/ComfyUI (.venv python3.14, torch 2.12+cu130); checkpoints at /mnt/nas-ai-models/checkpoints (SD1.5, SDXL, flux1Schnell, sd3, pony, SUPIR); CLIP ViT-L/14 openai/clip-vit-large-patch14 and timm/vit_large_patch14_clip_224.openai in HF cache
dimensions.abstention_policy: reject generations failing sanity checks (empty/discarded generation, sampler error, degenerate output); abstain when the diffusion checkpoint fails to decode relevant attributes (ceiling effect) and report it, never treating failure as a BETTER signal
dimensions.qualification_gate: PASS only after: (a) a frozen cohort and fixed ComfyUI checkpoint + sampler/generation settings; (b) a controlled one-axis comparison (full context vs baseline) scoring original vs generated with a fixed CLIP ViT-L/14 model; (c) calibration of the scoring on known cases and a null case (empty/meaningless prompt); (d) independent review of the reconstruction protocol; and (e) no corpus mutation, local-first, scheduler-managed GPU, noncanonical output only, additive artifacts only.
known_failure_modes: generative model does not reproduce identity/subject exactly
CLIP score is a weak identity proxy
GPU time per item is large
ceiling effect / degenerate similarity can make DELTA uninformative

specialists.name: ComfyUI reconstruction (SD1.5/SDXL/flux1Schnell)
specialists.scope: generate image from context4k/dossier; compare to source with CLIP ViT-L/14 similarity
known_failure_modes: generative model does not reproduce identity/subject exactly
CLIP score is a weak identity proxy
GPU time per item is large

dimensions.name: open-weight VLM dense multi-view description
dimensions.hypothesis: A locally-run open-weight VLM producing a dense, multi-view descriptive block for a single curated woman source image (full-frame + seg2-derived focal crops), routed claim-by-claim with abstention, materially raises supported-claim density on the frozen 24-item cohort versus the deterministic dossier alone, and is a legitimately-new evidence part toward the 100K expanded-dossier floor (option B of decision #46).
dimensions.falsified_if: The VLM dense description does not raise supported-claim density on the frozen cohort beyond the deterministic dossier + honest-expansion ceiling, or abstains at too low a rate to be trustworthy (unchecked verbosity), or is not distinguishable from a redundant attribute-tagger over already-validated axes.
dimensions.deterministic_signal: learned VLM dense description (Molmo-72B / Qwen2.5-VL / InternVL3-78B candidates; VERIFIED LOCALLY 2026-08-06: qwen3-vl:32b via Ollama on both 4090 and Strix accepts image input and emits [OBSERVED]/[INFERRED]/[ABSTAIN]-tagged dense prose, all 6 subsections, zero absolute-pixel leakage, scale-invariant prose; 4090 runs 27% CPU-offload (slow), Strix runs 100% GPU = production batch host; qwen3.5-9b (Mar 2026, Apache-2.0, 262K ctx) is a newer single-GPU open candidate) over full-frame + focal crops; each claim tagged observed/inferred/abstained; scale-invariant ratios only in prose
dimensions.data_snapshot: first-500 core-covered cohort; source pixels + seg2 crop regions; local Ollama/ComfyUI stack
dimensions.selection_rationale: The arm-36 honest expansion-ceiling audit proved deterministic evidence tops out at 2040-3489 tokens/item (7-50x below the 100K floor); a VLM dense-description specialist is the concrete option-B evidence source named in decision #46 and is a NEW evidence part per the open-world sourcing directive (local options exhausted).
dimensions.scope: dense multi-view descriptive prose for a single curated woman source image: full-frame + focal crops (face, upper body, garment regions derived from seg2); evidence prose, not a caption
dimensions.inputs: decoded source RGB full-frame + fixed focal crops derived from seg2 regions; frozen prompt
dimensions.output_semantics: structured markdown block of dense descriptive claims (subject, garments, hair, skin, setting, pose, facial detail), each claim tagged observed/inferred/abstained; no absolute pixel or raw-coordinate numbers in prose; scale-invariant ratios only; machine-readable measurements stay in evidence_payload JSON
dimensions.provenance: open weights run on owned hardware only (local 4090 via scheduler or Strix). Literature scan 2026-08-06: Molmo/Molmo-72B (AI2, fully open weights+data, PixMo dense-caption pretraining, top captioning benchmark; arXiv 2409.17146); Qwen2-VL-72B/Qwen2.5-VL (open weight, strongest MMMU/OCRBench); InternVL3-78B (MIT license). No hosted third-party inference of the sensitive corpus.
dimensions.abstention_policy: frozen prompt + deterministic crop policy; emit [ABSTAIN] on regions with insufficient visible pixels (motion blur/occlusion/DOF crop); detector/measurement disagreement is a quality anomaly, never content; no absolute pixel claim in prose
dimensions.qualification_gate: PASS only after: (a) frozen crop/prompt/view policy with pinned digests; (b) controlled document-utility check reproducing every fact deterministic specialists already declare on a known case AND adding materially more supported claims on the frozen 24-item cohort (claim-support rubric v1, same reviewer); (c) calibration on known cases + null case; (d) abstention audit (observed/inferred/abstained rates, unchecked verbosity is a fail); (e) independent adversarial review of the protocol; (f) no corpus mutation, local-first, scheduler-managed GPU, noncanonical output only, additive artifacts only.

evidence_budget.basis: measured honest expansion-ceiling audit, program-floor-aware (2026-08-06; run /mnt/nas-ai-models/research/stratum/dossier-expansion-audit-v2/): base deterministic dossier 387-648 tok/item; total record (prose+payload) 2040-3489; generous honest LM elaboration ceiling 8500-13500; under the reframed structural floor 4001 any_max_honest_floor_reached=true (24/24), deterministic record alone false
